data.one_liner: A Flutter package for displaying a dialog relative to another widget.
data.what_it_does: It allows Flutter developers to display a dialog positioned relative to a specific target widget. It supports an anchor widget approach or an imperative method call, along with customizable animations.
use_when: You need to show a popup or dialog positioned relative to a specific anchor widget
You want custom animations for dialog transitions relative to a target
avoid_when: You need standard center-screen modal dialogs provided by Flutter out of the box
strengths: Supports both an anchor widget and an imperative API
weaknesses: No advanced layout or alignment helpers mentioned beyond basic alignments
